newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading cools after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading cools after hours.

text.p: Traders said on Thursday after-hours activity was minimal, with no stocks trading far off their closing prices.
During market hours, Wall Street stocks fell 50 points as investors waited for Friday's payroll and wage report.

The New York Stock Exchange said its sesssion one volume was 38,100 shares compared to 14,900 shares on Wednesday. Session two volume was 844,600 shares compared to 12,238,481 shares on Wednesday, the NYSE said.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
